subject.title: [Bug] Telegram inbound images download but are not passed to model as vision input

question: Should current-turn image resolution forward source-aligned partial native images when some same-turn attachments fail, or keep the current all-or-nothing fallback until a broader media contract exists?
rationale: The user-facing bug is real, but the remaining open fix changes shared media delivery semantics and has already been flagged as needing contract and proof resolution.

options.title: Repair aligned partial delivery
options.body: Land PR 94139 or a replacement only after preserving source positions through the prompt boundary and adding real Telegram or equivalent transport proof.

options.title: Keep fallback behavior
options.body: Close or narrow PR 94139 if maintainers do not want partial native image delivery as the current contract.

options.title: Defer to broader media design
options.body: Leave the issue open but block implementation until a broader attachment alignment contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Repair aligned partial delivery
recommendation.body: Land PR 94139 or a replacement only after preserving source positions through the prompt boundary and adding real Telegram or equivalent transport proof.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc most recently authored the mixed image-order resolver contract that the partial-delivery decision must preserve.
